iti9:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti9:2.1: “Monks, one who has not fully known & fully understood greed, whose mind has not been cleansed of passion for it, has not abandoned it, is incapable of putting an end to stress.
iti9:2.2: But one who has fully known & fully understood greed, who has detached his mind from it and let go of it, is capable of putting an end to stress.”
